subject: Cross-cloud onramp MAP & procurement checkpoints — Illyria Technologies
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: samir.patel@illyria.ai, alicia.gomez@illyria.ai
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Cross-cloud onramp MAP & procurement checkpoints — Illyria Technologies

Hi Samir / Alicia —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation I pulled together a compact mutual action plan (MAP) focused on getting Illyria onto a private-offer purchase path (AWS Marketplace preferred per your infra team), while leaving the option open for GCP/Azure later in the program. The attached spreadsheet (illyria_MAP_v1.xlsx) lays out milestones, owners, target dates, and acceptance criteria. High-level plan below: 

- Week 0 (signaling): Confirm target private offer (AWS) and initial commit range (we discussed $250k–$500k annual). Owner: Illyria procurement.
- Week 1–2 (eval smoke tests): Redwood provides a 2-week POC environment (dedicated pool) with a sample workload, two evaluation prompts, and latency/cost baselines. Acceptance: 80% of baseline throughput at <250ms p50 for priority route. Owner: Redwood (Marissa).
- Week 3–4 (security & compliance): Share SOC2 snapshot and run short integration call for network/keys; Illyria to provide vendor questionnaire answers. Owner: Ben (security lead).
- Week 4–6 (contract & private-offer configuration): Draft private offer terms, finalize billing cadence (monthly invoicing, net 30 or AWS marketplace contract — confirm preference). Owner: Redwood sales/legal.
- Week 6–8 (procurement & PO): Illyria issues PO or accepts AWS private offer; Redwood sets up billing mapping and reserved capacity. Owner: Illyria procurement / Redwood billing.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm the commit band you want us to draft into the private-offer doc (we can put a two-tier structure: committed spend + overage pricing).
2) Alicia — please loop in your procurement contact (or send PO template) so we can align on invoicing fields.
3) I'll schedule the evaluation environment for Monday so Marissa can kick off the smoke tests.

Attachments: illyria_MAP_v1.xlsx, draft_AWS_Private_Offer.docx (placeholder).

Happy to iterate on the MAP — short call works best if you want to walk the timelines.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

---
Attachment stubs: illyria_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), draft_AWS_Private_Offer.docx (Word)
From: samir.patel@illyria.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@illyria.ai, alicia.gomez@illyria.ai
Date: 2028-07-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud onramp MAP & procurement checkpoints — Illyria Technologies

Laura —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear plan. A few clarifying items from procurement and engineering after our sync: 

- Commitment band: Procurement likes having a fixed first-year commitment to leverage better pricing. Can you draft the private-offer with two options: $300k committed / $450k committed, both with a 12-month term and volume discount tiers?
- Invoicing: Prefer AWS private-offer billing through Marketplace (so AWS invoices us) but we may need a backup monthly invoice from Redwood for accounting reconciliation. Is that supported?
- Security: We received the SOC2 snapshot — thanks. Our security team still needs the answers to the vendor questionnaire (we have a 15-question pdf). Can Ben run a quick review this week?
- Evaluation: Engineering wants an additional synthetic workload test (long-sequence stability test) included alongside the two evaluation prompts. Can Marissa add that to the POC acceptance criteria?

Procurement has attached our standard PO template (PO-template-Illyria.docx) — please use it when we reach the PO step.

Also copying Alicia (engineering lead) to confirm timelines. If we can keep to your Week 6–8 cadence that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Samir
VP Product, Illyria Technologies
samir.patel@illyria.ai
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: samir.patel@illyria.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-19T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud onramp MAP & procurement checkpoints — Illyria Technologies

Thanks Samir — happy to take the evaluation pieces. Per the MAP: I updated the POC acceptance criteria in the spreadsheet (drive link included in the MAP). Summary of changes: 

- Added long-sequence stability test (10k token stream, 3 concurrent sessions) with pass threshold: no model restarts and <1% error rate.
- Added a latency sweep target across 256 / 1024 / 2048 sequence lengths; reporting will include token-cost estimates for each.
- I'll provision a dedicated evaluation pool starting Monday (2028-07-23) and post credentials to the shared drive.

Ben — can you confirm the SOC2 questionnaire turnaround? I indicated we'll aim for 3 business days for initial answers and then schedule a security 30-min sync if needed.

Samir / Alicia — I'll also include a short performance runbook with recommended prompt batching and caching options that will be used in the POC.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

---
Attachment referenced: SOC2-Snapshot-2028-04.pdf (security summary)
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: procurement@illyria.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-19T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud onramp MAP & procurement checkpoints — Illyria Technologies

Hi Illyria procurement team —

Thanks for sending the PO template. I reviewed your 15-question vendor questionnaire and attached a short pack with answers to the most common items. Key notes: 

- SOC2: full report available under NDA; SOC2 snapshot included (SOC2-Snapshot-2028-04.pdf). We can sign an NDA if needed; otherwise we can provide a redacted report.
- Network & keys: Redwood supports VPC peering or customer-managed endpoints; for the POC we recommend managed endpoints plus ephemeral keys.
- Data retention & audit logs: configurable retention windows; audit logs can be exported for your SIEM.

I'll be available for the 30-min security sync on Thursday (2028-07-21) at 10:00 PT — does that work for you?

Ben Carter
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: alicia.gomez@illyria.ai
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@illyria.ai
Date: 2028-07-21T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-cloud onramp MAP & procurement checkpoints — Illyria Technologies

Team —

All good from our side. Procurement confirmed the $300k commit (we'll start there), and procurement will issue a PO using the attached template next Wednesday pending the security sync results. A few items for the final block: 

- Please prepare the AWS private-offer draft at the $300k level with monthly usage reconciliation via Marketplace and a secondary monthly invoice option for internal tracking.
- Can you add a short clause about fallback routing and capacity guarantees during sustained spikes? (Our ops team wants assurance on graceful degradation & failover).
- We accepted the POC scope including the long-sequence stability test. Marissa — look for a test data dump from our engineering team by Monday.

If you can send the private-offer draft and a DocuSign-ready agreement, procurement will be able to execute quickly after the PO.

Thanks — Alicia
Director, Engineering — Illyria Technologies
alicia.gomez@illyria.ai

---
Next steps: Laura to circulate private-offer draft (we'll use the draft_AWS_Private_Offer.docx) and DocuSign link; Marissa to spin up POC environment on 2028-07-23; Ben to run security sync 2028-07-21 10:00 PT.
